name: @js-joda/locale
description: plugin for locale functionality for js-joda
author: phueper

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build-dist && npm run build-locale-dist
scripts.test: npm run build-source && npm run build-cldr && NODE_PATH='../../.build/node_modules' NODE_ENV=test npm run with-source -- npx mocha --timeout 5000 --require @babel/register ./test/*Test.js ./test/**/*Test.js ./test/**/**/*Test.js test/pluginTest_mochaOnly.js
scripts.test-coverage: npm run build-source && npm run build-cldr && NODE_PATH='../../.build/node_modules' NODE_ENV=test npm run with-source -- npx c8 --temp-directory ../../.c8_output --clean=false --report-dir=build/coverage --reporter=lcov --reporter=html npx mocha --timeout 5000 --require @babel/register --reporter progress ./test/*Test.js ./test/**/*Test.js ./test/**/**/*Test.js
scripts.test-browser: npm run build-source && npm run with-source -- tsx ../../tools/src/commands/karma-run.ts --reporters=dots --single-run
scripts.test-ci: npm run build-dist && npm run build-locale-dist && npm run test && npm run test-browser && npm run test-ts-definitions && npm run test-coverage
scripts.build-dist: npm run build-source && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' npm run with-source -- npx rollup -c rollup.config.ts
scripts.build-examples: npm run build-source && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' npm run with-source -- npx rollup -c rollup-examples.config.ts
scripts.build-prebuilt: rm -rf dist/prebuilt/*; npm run build-source && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' npm run with-source -- npx rollup -c rollup-prebuilt.config.ts
scripts.build-locale-dist: npm run build-examples && npm run build-prebuilt && npm run create-packages
